title: Steel plate made by hand at the Central Nexus workshop from the pilot's own stored iron ore, kept in its storage there for the reserve; open to a ship of any role
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-17 03:58 UTC (requests.log ENT-190: the steel craft as the fleet's second kind of standing work, beside gathering). basic_iron_smelting makes 1 steel plate from 10 iron ore by hand at the station workshop, 0 cr, 0.27 ticks a run (guidebook logistics.md, section 14). Standing work for a ship of any role: requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage here holds one run's iron (25 runs take 250 iron ore); the plates stay in that pilot's storage for the reserve. Stored here in the book of 03:47 UTC: 39,929 iron ore, 5 pilots with 300 or more. max_ships 2: what that ore carries for four hours at about 7 minutes a run. A test: its first RESULT line is read before more ships.
